project: THE STOCK MARKET: FROM THE GROUND UP (Crownlight)
source_basis: Authoritative and provider methodology references plus original fictional calculations; user-supplied Master Research Source Directory is a research index, not a grant of publication rights

records.method: close EMA, alpha=2/(period+1), seed=SMA(first period closes)
records.warmup: first value at index period-1; no earlier EMA
records.limitation: EMA seed and warmup vary between providers; rising EMA does not predict the next close

records.method: Wilder RSI, initial average gain/loss from first period price changes, then recursively smooth
records.inputs: completed positive closing prices; period plus starting close
records.warmup: first RSI at index period; both zero averages map to project-defined 50
records.limitation: Momentum indicator, not a guaranteed next-bar entry signal; zero-average convention must be specified

records.method: fast EMA minus slow EMA; signal EMA of valid MACD values; histogram=MACD-signal
records.inputs: completed closes; fast, slow, signal periods
records.warmup: SMA-seed both component EMAs and subsequent MACD signal; no premature lines
records.limitation: Illustrative 3/5/3 differs from common 12/26/9; methods and seeding affect early values

records.method: True range=max(high-low,abs(high-priorClose),abs(low-priorClose)); Wilder smoothed ATR in project implementation
records.inputs: completed H/L/C bars; prior close; period
records.warmup: first TR=high-low, first ATR=SMA(period true ranges), then Wilder recursive smoothing
records.limitation: ATR is an absolute volatility scale, not trade direction; providers can choose different first-bar TR initialization

records.method: middle=SMA(period closes); upper/lower=middle ± multiplier × population standard deviation
records.inputs: completed closes; window period and multiplier
records.warmup: first bands at index period-1; project explicitly uses population divisor period
records.limitation: Band contact alone does not establish reversal; sample-versus-population deviation must not be silently interchanged

records.method: exact transaction VWAP=sum(tradePrice × tradeVolume)/sum(tradeVolume) over chosen reset interval
records.inputs: individual executed trade prints and traded sizes, session or stated anchor
records.warmup: requires positive cumulative traded volume; reset at stated session/anchor
records.limitation: Cannot reconstruct exact trade-print VWAP from aggregate OHLCV; no exchange-feed redistribution rights inferred

records.method: bar proxy=sum(((high+low+close)/3) × barVolume)/sum(barVolume) over stated reset interval
records.inputs: completed OHLCV bars, known bar volume, session/anchor
records.warmup: requires positive cumulative bar volume; proxy remains approximate from bar-level aggregates
records.limitation: Bar-based HLC3 VWAP is NOT mathematically identical to exact transaction VWAP; label proxy prominently
